scope: One ring-finger base-joint corrective, static talisman and flashlight samples; not complete hand art or all-frame collision validation.

talismanSkin.measurement: Unity BakeMesh triangle area compared with neutral bind, below 25 percent

flashlightSurface.measurement: Weighted vertices including active blendshape against measured cylinder approximation, static pose

limitations: Talisman result is a single static pose, not every animation frame
Flashlight is a cylinder approximation, not a full mesh intersection test
Full game scene appearance and frame rate were not measured
